name: git merge
purpose: Combine changes from another branch into the currently checked-out branch.
explanation: Integrates commits from `<sourceBranch>` (such as `feature-login`) into your current branch (such as `main`).

parameters.description: Name of the branch whose commits you want to merge into the current branch.

example:
git checkout main
git merge feature-login
explanationOfOutput: Confirms commits from `feature-login` have been integrated into `main`.
whenToUse: After finishing and reviewing feature branch work to bring it into `main`.
commonMistakes: Running `git merge main` while still on `feature-login` instead of checking out `main` first.
